name: VSS Enum (SA)
help: Enumerates Volume Shadow Copy snapshots on a remote share
long_help: Lists available Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) snapshots on a remote SMB share using the FSCTL_SRV_ENUMERATE_SNAPSHOTS control code. Shadow copies can be accessed via paths like \\server\share\@GMT-YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS. Works on Server 2012 and later with Previous Versions enabled.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target server hostname or IP address

arguments.name: sharename
arguments.desc: SMB share name to enumerate snapshots on (default: C$)
